scope: Read-only whole-game actor intelligence, useful roles and animation planning audit

gaps.finding: Every actor is still recorded REQUIRED_NOT_YET_PROVEN; schema names and historical task statuses do not certify current runtime intelligence or motion.
No explicit survivor purchase/upgrade budget authority or full processing/service/resupply/rescue delegation contract in the current actor registry.

T08 crosswalk preserves unlimited logical player inventory separately from finite worker capacity; latest request for large player-like mixed carrying needs an explicit policy decision, not guessed counts.

Current36profile registry covers specific harvesting/attacks and a few other actions; it does not constitute complete per-actor locomotion/carry/deposit/heal/rescue/purchase/hurt/recovery coverage or equipment/enemy state inventory.

T31 has job arbitration/navigation contention intent, but no frozen complete job-phase, lease, preemption, fallback, authorization-revocation or success/utility scenario contract in the four reviewed registries.

Pet role families and motion are already required; no per-species measured usefulness/combined-team acceptance scenario is defined in those registries. Pet-specific behaviors are authored Havenline design, not direct video-observed behavior.
Survivor metal/fuel/fish/wheat profiles contain T23_FREEZE_REQUIRED, while placeholder_tokens omit that exact token. Existing schema checks do not prove complete action use-state coverage.

new_user_requirements: Smart and useful survivors and pets fitting the game
Survivors assist all practical human gameplay tasks including buying plots
Survivors carry large useful mixed resource loads like the player
Complete meaningful action and equipment/enemy/pet animation
Every collectible resource/currency supports worthwhile progression or play

human_task_families.requirement: Chop, mine, registered salvage, fish, crop harvest and hunt using the actual tool/resource method. Training and equipment may gate readiness; no permanent arbitrary survivor-only exclusion.
Pick up, visibly carry large mixed loads, reserve destination capacity, deposit, retrieve and transfer every permitted registered resource with typed conservation.
Feed, operate where attended operation is real, empty and restock machines; preserve recipe/input/output identity, manual-only goods and conveyor restrictions.
Fulfil reserved orders, visibly hand off goods, collect committed ordinary payment and reinvest only under delegated authority.
Fund and complete player-authorized plot purchases, unlocks and upgrades through the same exactly-once world transaction contract; protected resource reserves and per-order budget apply.
Build, repair, clear approved jams and restore interrupted production; player layout changes require an explicit work order, never autonomous base rearrangement.
Guard, fight, hunt, intercept and restock authorized defensive structures using valid target, weapon, ammunition and friendly-safety contracts.
Rescue, escort, move an injured ally where supported, deliver to shelter/care and heal with valid equipment and actual animations; use safe roles rather than all workers charging danger.
Load, unload, deliver and operate an approved transport role in every applicable region; region access and equipment apply equally, and industrial belts do not carry living actors.
Notice only information actually available to that agent, identify a useful safe job, respond to a small set of player priorities and communicate the present task or concrete blocked reason.

worker_capacity_decision.preserve: Unlimited logical player inventory and readable finite visual stacks.
worker_capacity_decision.new_requirement: Large useful mixed survivor loads and meaningful logistics assistance.
worker_capacity_decision.existing_worker_policy: Finite worker capacity is explicitly named in the source crosswalk.
must_decide: Whether worker logical capacity remains finite/upgradable or moves to player-like logical capacity
Relative capacity and throughput targets by unlocked stage
Interaction with machine, storage and delivery capacity
worker_capacity_decision.shared_contract: All human carriers use one capacity/custody/progression schema with actor-specific configured limits only after authoring approval. Capacity upgrades, training and equipment change real throughput and visible handling together; no hardcoded one-item helper or duplicated special inventory model.

requirements: Order identifies exact target plot/upgrade or an explicit allowlist; actor may not invent an expansion chain.
Player authorizes ordinary in-game resource/cash budget, stock minimums, job priority and whether already reserved partial payments may finish.
Immediately before commit revalidate target revision/prerequisites, cost, budget remainder, current permissions and safety. Price/target change cannot silently increase the approved budget.

Cancellation or budget withdrawal releases uncommitted reservations and restores any uncommitted escrow through the same authoritative transaction. A committed purchase remains correctly recorded and cannot be charged again.
No autonomous premium-currency spend, paid purchase, VIP entitlement change, billing or real-money checkout. Such user-owned decisions remain explicitly initiated by the player.
Human survivors may physically deliver approved resources and complete plots. Pet assistance stays within species capabilities; pets do not become human cashiers, purchase agents or tool users.
Show locked, affordable, partial, paid, building and complete state using actual transaction state and selected pad renders; fade only after completion.
No debt, negative inventory, double spending, duplicated grants or hidden reassignment of a player-reserved input; retained audit identifies actor, order and exact transaction.

ai_requirements.title: Eligibility before desire
ai_requirements.requirement: Check actor capability, task ownership, equipment/training, known targets, environmental readiness, budget authorization, input availability and output capacity before claiming work.

ai_requirements.title: Stable useful priorities
ai_requirements.requirement: Use a small number of player goals plus world safety/need priorities. Emergency protection/rescue, critical fuel or food supply and useful throughput must outrank decorative idle; commit/hysteresis prevents rapid job flipping.

ai_requirements.title: Shared reservations
ai_requirements.requirement: Reserve job target/work position, actual typed inputs, destination capacity and permitted ordinary spend atomically. Two agents cannot reserve the same final unit or complete the same plot twice.

ai_requirements.title: Safe preemption
ai_requirements.requirement: Define preemptible phases and the authoritative commit point. On danger, recall, priority change or target loss, preserve carried items, unwind unused reservations and either resume or reassign without double payment/damage/yield.

ai_requirements.title: Player agency
ai_requirements.requirement: Player can reprioritize, recall, pause or revoke a delegated order through a small set of contextual controls. Crew cannot override a current player operation or consume its reserved resources.

ai_requirements.title: Path and population recovery
ai_requirements.requirement: Prove both bidirectional gates with loaded humans and large animals, occupancy handoffs, bounded replan, blocked-route retry and visible safe fallback. No pushing the player, ghosting through walls or permanent crowd deadlock.

ai_requirements.title: Target-claimed recovery
ai_requirements.requirement: If a target is claimed, depleted, moved, upgraded, destroyed or unsafe before arrival, reassess. A worker switches to useful eligible work or states a concrete reason; it does not hammer empty air.

ai_requirements.title: Cargo custody
ai_requirements.requirement: Carry records identify type, quantity, owner, reservation and destination. Partial unload, spill/recovery if designed, interruption, full destination and handoff cannot delete, duplicate or silently transmute cargo.

ai_requirements.title: Fairness and bottlenecks
ai_requirements.requirement: Share targets and work positions fairly, age delayed valid jobs, and relieve a useful bottleneck without starving fuel/food/defense or circulating storage OUT back into storage IN.

ai_requirements.title: Survival-aware assistance
ai_requirements.requirement: Agents recognize readable danger and their own ability to complete an order, seek shelter/care if required, escort vulnerable actors and avoid repeatedly entering the same failed route.

ai_requirements.title: Truthful perception
ai_requirements.requirement: No omniscient target selection, hidden resources, attacks through geometry or benefits from a scouting action before discovery actually occurs.

ai_requirements.title: Save and interruption integrity
ai_requirements.requirement: Persist actor identity, current phase, carried items, committed costs and reservation ownership. Reload/app interruption, retry and migration recreate neither actors nor rewards nor debits.

ai_requirements.title: Performance without gameplay cheating
ai_requirements.requirement: Bound decision/path/animation cost at realistic populations on target phones. Presentation detail or evaluation cadence may change only without altering authoritative outcomes, cargo, contact/hit timing or protected ownership.

ai_requirements.title: Explainable useful behavior
ai_requirements.requirement: At normal gameplay camera the player can tell what the helper is doing, why it stopped, and what useful outcome it achieved. No high-frequency popups or complex management dashboard is required.

pet_roles.proposal_scope: Operational examples within existing species capabilities; numeric balance and new physical attachments remain authored decisions.

pet_roles.proposal_scope: Operational examples within existing species capabilities; numeric balance and new physical attachments remain authored decisions.

pet_roles.proposal_scope: Operational examples within existing species capabilities; numeric balance and new physical attachments remain authored decisions.

pet_roles.proposal_scope: Operational examples within existing species capabilities; numeric balance and new physical attachments remain authored decisions.

animation_coverage_families.proof_requirement: Foot/toe/knee contact, grip and gear/cargo clearance at actual gameplay speed; scale stays bound to approved renders.
Each actual method/tool has authored role-appropriate motion; impact triggers exactly one authoritative resource event.
Visible item identity and contact match custody; no free material from gestures, success on denial or visual pad disappearance before completion.
Meaningful rescue and care actions require hand/body contact, target response and actual improved state.
Weapon-specific mechanics, human-role motion and damage authority; legibility and friendly safety.
Paws, shoulders, tails, fur/mane, jaws/talons and carry contacts; meaningful species jobs, not a scaled shared attack loop.
Full aerial navigation, wing clearance and perch transitions in actual playback; no ground-animal substitute.
Different machines visibly perform their actual function, and stop/respond to shortages/backpressure. Central warming furnace stays distinct from an unapproved smelter recipe.
Cargo remains supported and typed; service and cargo ports separate; actual paid handoff and cash states readable.
Visible aim/shot/reload/contact corresponds to actual target and ammunition; no ornamental firing or invented ore ammunition.
Each shipped archetype/weapon/locomotion family needs readable unique authored behavior and full transitions; separate friendly companions, huntable wildlife and hostile roles.

Animate functional changes and authored ambient life where appropriate. Static architecture need not move without purpose; critical state changes remain clear with sound muted and reduced-motion settings.

animation_event_contract: Each action row binds actor/asset/version, target, eligibility, clip/mechanism, entry/loop/exit, cancel/preempt points, authoritative contact/commit event, sound/visual equivalents and source-bound actual playback proof.
Logical state controls clips and sounds; clip pose alone cannot produce success, inventory, damage or payment.
Distinct meaningful views, normal gameplay camera, close contact view, full cycles and every required transition; exact-source video and actual listening evidence, not only screenshots.
Preserve full strong current >=9.9 reference and exact10 visual/motion requirements; no averaging away a failed area.
Designed static architecture, deliberate silence or justified shared motion may be explicit dispositions; never a missing-use-state excuse or a generic placeholder.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Human task parity
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: For every human gameplay task family and applicable resource/region, demonstrate the trained/equipped survivor route and actual action result; exceptions require an explicit owner decision, not an accidental missing capability.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Useful large mixed cargo
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Compare actual trip throughput and readable mixed-load handling with the player/logistics goal; validate selected capacity policy rather than claiming an unchosen count. Full/partial destinations and two-gate congestion retain every unit.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Delegated plot completion
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Player approves a target and budget; workers gather/transport/contribute/commit/build once. Concurrent player/worker arrival, partial funding, cancellation, budget withdrawal and reload never duplicate debit or unlock.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Emergency preemption
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: During delivery or work, introduce a threat or vulnerable ally. Eligible agents protect/retreat/reassign while conserving cargo and unused reservations, then resume useful work.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Target and route failure
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Claim/deplete/move the target, close one route, fill the output, interrupt an animation and revoke authorization. Each agent chooses a valid recovery or a truthful blocked state without thrashing/deadlock.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Pet value by species
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Each of seven pets completes a distinct useful scenario, then a mixed-team scenario. Compare resulting safety, useful delivery, discovery or throughput with an idle companion; do not claim a tuned numeric benefit without measurement.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Complete motion inventory
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Every introduced action/state has an authored clip/mechanism or explicit justified static/reused disposition and source-bound evidence. Play full cycles and transitions at normal speed and slow inspection with distinct meaningful views.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Animation/accounting alignment
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Verify one authoritative yield, transaction, damage or reward event per valid contact/commit; miss, cancelled and replayed animation produce none. Reload at the commit boundary cannot duplicate outcomes.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Listening and mute equivalence
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Listen to actual candidate cues and music transitions under simultaneous machines/crowds/combat. Alerts retain visual equivalents, concurrency is bounded, and optional idle variety does not mask danger or force noise.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Population/device integration
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Run realistic population, wildlife, pets and working machinery on required devices/modes, including app interruption and long sessions; keep gameplay authority and critical readability under the budget.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Progression and autonomy
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: At early and late milestones, helpers reduce repetitive chores while meaningful player route, defense and expansion choices remain. Every major action is automatable when unlocked without mandatory paid help.

acceptance_scenarios.name: Reference and asset identity
acceptance_scenarios.required_demonstration: Selected GitHub render commit/path/hash maps to actual model/rig/scene and full use-state clips; do not treat static render approval or an old source review as current motion/AI approval.

scope_limits: No actual build run, motion playback, listening, intelligence benchmark or device certification in this read-only plan audit.
No claim that missing registry entry proves a clip is absent from every archived/runtime branch.
No new task IDs/dependency edges/assignments/statuses or past receipts changed.

Future task owners freeze actual chosen behavior and evidence on the then-current approved foundation; this audit does not activate LOCKED tasks.
